columns.name: License Number
columns.description: The Public Chauffeur license number issued to the licensee.

columns.name: Renewed
columns.description: The date (month/year) the license was last renewed.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The current status of the license (Active, Hold, Suspended, Denied, Revoked, Inactive).

columns.name: Status Date
columns.description: The date the license status was last updated.

columns.name: Expires
columns.description: The date (month/year) the license expired or will expire.

columns.name: Driver Type
columns.description: The type of public passenger vehicle the licensee is authorized to operate (Taxi, Livery Only, or Horse-Drawn Only).

columns.name: License Type
columns.description: The license term issued to the licensee (Permanent with a one-year term or Temporary with a defined term less than one year).

columns.name: Original Issue Date
columns.description: The date the licensee was issued his/her first Public Chauffeur license under the indicated license number.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The name of the person issued the Public Chauffeur license.

columns.name: Last Valid Date
columns.description:
The last date on which this version of the record appeared.

It indicates when this version STOPPED being valid (or is the last refresh time of this dataset for current records). See dataset description for more discussion of this column.

columns.name: Record Version ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that has no meaning beyond distinguishing different versions of the same license.
